Overview

Tetouan is a city in Tanger-Tétouan-Al Hoceïma with a population of 380,000. A mountain-fringed city in northern Morocco, known for its whitewashed medina and strong Andalusian heritage. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
